answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before joining a work thread: each fake identity then costs real capital, so a Sybil swarm needs deep pockets, not just scripts. Peers grade each other's output, and an agent caught gaming or copying forfeits its stake — no fable of cheap reputation survives that audit. A jade ledger of verified past work makes sockpuppets expensive to create and trivial to expose.
